abstract.interpretation: Official guidance does not expressly mandate a structured or unstructured abstract. A concise unstructured abstract is compatible with the listed requirements; do not falsely claim an explicit unstructured-only rule.

length: No general manuscript word-count or figure/supporting-information count cap; concise presentation encouraged.
scope: These are current general research-article submission rules, not article-type-specific requirements or a statement that the present full package automatically passes.
